role: limited retrospective experiment on historically open development/reporting panels; not an independent test

data_and_splits.policy_source: artifacts/frozen_policy/cache/{train,common}; Frozen development/reporting user IDs reused unchanged
data_and_splits.rm_dev_users: original C RM holdout: SHA256(hex-prefix 76345f323a433a726d6465763a + decimal uid) first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 5 equals 0
data_and_splits.rm_fit_users: original C fit users only; dev users never enter fit
data_and_splits.large_rows_selection: preserve all 21290 original fit rows; deduplicate by (uid, sequence position); per-user event order uses existing residual_support hash SHA256('residual_support:rm:17:{uid}:{position}'); added rows are dealt round-robin in ascending SHA256('rm_scaling:rm-expand:{uid}') order, to a cap of 40 fit rows per user; stop at 100000 or eligible exhaustion

reward_models.small_base: reuse artifacts/policy_diagnostics/rm/C_refit_residual_support_optimized_control.joblib, same original 21290 fit rows and 35 features
reward_models.small_affinity: reuse artifacts/policy_diagnostics/rm/C_prefix_safe_affinity_extension.joblib, same original 21290 fit rows and 44 features
reward_models.large_base: new HistGradientBoostingRegressor fit on expanded nested rows and same 35 features
reward_models.large_affinity: new HistGradientBoostingRegressor fit on the identical expanded nested rows and same 44 features
reward_models.dev: same untouched 5133 original C RM-dev rows; never fit these users/rows

policy.architecture: 54->64->64->1 MLP with SiLU and zero-initialized output
policy.kl: exact conditional KL, weighted by fixed reference support mass
policy.paired_initialization: same torch initialization per seed across all S/L/E/A branches
policy.paired_batch_order: separate batch RNG seeded identically by seed across branches; action RNG separated from context-batch RNG
policy.checkpoint_selection: trained step > 0 with highest policy-development next-item NDCG@10; ties by lower mass-weighted KL, then earlier step; reporting/24h not used

A.features: all 54; nine standardized affinity columns zeroed in train/dev/reporting

policy.v5_baselines: reuse selected Frozen old_deployed sampled-LOO RL and exact-gradient checkpoint for each seed from artifacts/frozen_policy/reporting_selection.json

evaluation.primary_v6_question: large affinity RM policy L: 24h positive-nonorganic multi-target NDCG@10 versus S and strong reference
evaluation.primary_v5_metric_remains: next-item user-macro NDCG@10 on the Frozen reporting panel; Scaling does not rename or replace it
evaluation.next_item: user-macro next-item NDCG@10 and HR@10; OOV targets count as misses; same users and denominator
evaluation.24h: exact Frozen target construction: events after target.position (next-item target excluded), within complete 86400-second horizon and same split, recommendable nonorganic events with finite ratio >= 0.5, unique raw item IDs, OOV retained in denominator; empty target sets NA
evaluation.24h_new_repeat: classify each positive target ID using only whether that ID occurs in full available history before recommendation; future repeats do not change new classification; separate nonempty denominator for each slice
evaluation.behavior: top-10 history-repeat share, mean available past-history length, most frequent recommended item share of all top-10 slots, top-10 unique-catalog coverage, mass-weighted KL, normalized reward delta
evaluation.uncertainty: per-user metrics retained for each seed; first average within user over seeds, then paired user bootstrap, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 20261022; raw 95% and Bonferroni 97.5% intervals for L-S and L-strong 24h NDCG only
evaluation.external_predictor: one frozen predictor pass on common reporting support for strong/S/L/E and reference; diagnostic only
evaluation.temporal_panel: optional; skipped if core pipeline approaches budget or requires a new feature cache beyond the fixed protocol
